reason: Correct a numerical degeneracy discovered in the first M5 full-audit run: mathematically identical shared-mean pair similarities differed at floating-point roundoff and were incorrectly passed to Spearman scoring.

affected_decisions.value: treat a finite vector as constant when its peak-to-peak range is at most 1e-12 times max(1, maximum absolute value)
affected_decisions.rationale: Makes the existing non-estimable constant-score rule robust to matrix-multiplication roundoff; it changes no formal prediction or non-degenerate metric definition.

results_status_at_amendment: The first M5 context table had been generated. The shared-mean target-identity rho was approximately -0.0009 despite a theoretically constant predicted similarity matrix; formal entrant outputs were not changed.
